quarantined.reason: real-device JSEngine parse failure: SyntaxError missing } after property list

notes: Test9 fixes the Test8 performance regression. Detail rendering performs exactly one detail request and never follows iframe/player/nested-player pages synchronously. Playback uses direct media already present in the detail HTML when available; otherwise it targets the detected iframe/player page with webRule and returns video.currentSrc/source or the first captured m3u8/mp4 resource, while blocking images and ad resources. This is a targeted browser-assisted bridge, not yet a proven pure API no-sniff implementation.
